election.source_note: Bilt Rewards Card Offer Terms, last updated October 27, 2026 (bilt.com/terms/bilt-card-offer-terms), read by engineering on 2026-11-15 for ENG-02B; Argon to confirm against the published text. Rewards Option for accounts opened before 2027, until their first Card Anniversary Date on or after January 1, 2027: selectable in the app, a change takes effect on the first day of the next Billing Cycle. From that anniversary it continues only under a Legacy Election. Not offered to accounts opened on or after January 1, 2027. Card Anniversary Date: one year after the first day of the first Billing Cycle that begins after the Account Open Date, then the same day each year. anniversary_cycle_days 62 is an engineering allowance for where that day can fall, NOT a published figure; anniversary_on on the holding replaces it.
